slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110 hours of weekly production time a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or is it the regular-time capacity where any additional hours beyond 110 count as overtime that you want to minimize?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the nature of the 110-hour capacity, which is related, but did not clarify whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a soft goal or its priority relative to minimizing overtime. The final model treats it only as an upper-bound capacity constraint.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on how many overtime hours per week the factory is allowed to work, or can overtime be any non-negative amount as long as it is minimized?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime limit exists, but did not clarify whether the 10-hour limit is a strict constraint or a soft goal, nor its priority relative to minimizing overtime. The final model treats it as a hard upper bound.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour regular-time capacity is only an upper bound; fully utilizing it is not modeled as a prioritized soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The user only said 110 hours is regular-time capacity, not whether full utilization is a goal or what priority it has. The final model enforces R_c + R_cl <= 110 without any goal-deviation variable.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a hard upper bound that cannot be treated as a soft target.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The user only stated that overtime should not exceed 10 hours. The agent did not confirm whether this is strict or a prioritized goal, but the final model imposes O_c + O_cl <= 10 as a hard constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden slots about the goal nature/priority of the 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime limit were only partially clarified. The final model hard-codes both as ordinary capacity constraints.

summary: The agent asked related capacity questions but did not fully recover the preemptive goal-programming structure: it never clarified whether full 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime limit are soft goals or what their priorities are. It then stopped and modeled both as hard constraints, leaving both P0 slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
